name: Lottery MAX fade
note: Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw MAX. MAX(N) is the mean of the N largest returns in the trailing formation window - an order statistic of the return distribution's right tail, not a moment. The single-ticker variant: short when MAX(N) sits above the 90th percentile of the ticker's OWN trailing history of MAX(N), long below the 10th, held for one formation window.
source: Turan G. Bali, Nusret Cakici and Robert F. Whitelaw, 'Maxing out: Stocks as lotteries and the cross-section of expected returns', Journal of Financial Economics 99(2), 2011, 427-446 - VERIFIED by reading the PDF at http://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~rwhitela/papers/max jfe11.pdf. Abstract: 'a negative and significant relation between the maximum daily return over the past one month (MAX) and expected stock returns. Average raw and risk-adjusted return differences between stocks in the lowest and highest MAX deciles exceed 1% per month.' p.2: value-weighted decile spread is -1.03%, four-factor alpha -1.18%, July 1962 to December 2005, and 'the results are robust to sorting stocks not only on the single maximum daily return during the month, but also the average of the two, three, four, or five highest daily returns within the month'. Underpinning theory: Barberis and Huang (2008) on probability weighting; Kumar (2009) on lottery-type stocks.

def family_init(ctx):
    import bisect
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    r = [0.0] * n
    for t in range(1, n):
        r[t] = (c[t] / c[t - 1] - 1.0) if c[t - 1] > 0.0 else 0.0

    F = int(ctx.p.form)
    N = max(1, min(int(ctx.p.n_max), F))
    mx = [None] * n
    win = []
    for t in range(n):
        bisect.insort(win, r[t])
        if len(win) > F:
            old = r[t - F]
            k = bisect.bisect_left(win, old)
            if k < len(win) and win[k] == old:
                del win[k]
        if t >= F and len(win) >= F:
            mx[t] = sum(win[-N:]) / float(N)

    H = int(ctx.p.hist_win)
    idx = [t for t in range(n) if mx[t] is not None]
    vals = [mx[t] for t in idx]
    rk = [None] * n
    w2 = []
    for k in range(len(idx)):
        bisect.insort(w2, vals[k])
        if len(w2) > H:
            old = vals[k - H]
            j = bisect.bisect_left(w2, old)
            if j < len(w2) and w2[j] == old:
                del w2[j]
        if len(w2) >= H:
            rk[idx[k]] = bisect.bisect_left(w2, vals[k]) / float(len(w2))
    ctx.rk = rk
    ctx.mx = mx
    ctx.start = F + H + 2


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < ctx.start:
        return 0
    q = ctx.rk[i]
    if q is None:
        return 0
    hi = float(ctx.p.pct_hi)
    lo = 1.0 - hi
    if q >= hi:
        return -1
    if q <= lo:
        return 1
    return 0
